newsitem.title: USA: Editek plans to double authorized shares.
newsitem.headline: Editek plans to double authorized shares.

text.p: Editek Inc said Tuesday that its board has adopted a resolution amending its certificate of incorporation to increase the number of authorized shares of common stock from 30,000,000 to 60,000,000.
The company said the amendment is subject to approval by shareholders at its annual meeting.

If approved by shareholders, the increase in authorized shares will enable Editek to issue shares of common stock to holders of convertible preferred stock, and also enable common stock to be issued to the seller of Medtox assets which Editek purchased in 1995.
